name: Queen Beatrix
source:
Queen of Fairy Island, where only female fairies live.
She is an egoistic person who values beautiful things and cannot resist acquiring them.
She strongly dislikes the existence of men, whom she saw for the first time after coming to the human world.
She wants to conquer the world, eradicate men, and obtain strong and beautiful fairy flowers.
She sees the main character's desire and gives him power. ......?

[Translated from [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item194528/af-6214]Gyutto[/url]]
